purpose: Teach: 附帯/インテリジェンス/ウェブページ/所信/タイマー/ハンディ/モデリング/クリアー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の附帯資料も丁寧にまとめろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure you organize the supplementary materials for the paper carefully.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Measured pace. The tone of someone who has high standards and expects they'll be met. No wasted words, slight weight on 「丁寧に」.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データインテリジェンス分析を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with the data intelligence analysis.
lines.style: Straightforward, respectful. Quick intake of breath at the start. Steady pace, no hesitation. The careful attentiveness of someone taking notes mentally as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のウェブページを更新しろ
lines.style: Factual, efficient. Clipped delivery. No inflection to soften the command, but not unkind either. The voice of someone delegating what needs doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教員に所信を伝えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll convey my understanding to my advisor.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slight pause after 'yes' as if mentally confirming the task. Even pacing, earnest underneath. The voice of someone taking responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験のタイマー管理を徹底しろ
lines.en: Ren — be strict about timer management in the experiments.
lines.style: Firm emphasis on precision. Clear attack on the first word. The tone carries weight—this matters. Not angry, but demanding attention. Slight lean forward in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データのハンディ端末入力も活用します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also make use of the handheld terminal for inputting experimental data.
lines.style: Respectful and methodical. Slightly formal register. Measured delivery, each phrase distinct. Shows he's heard the instruction and thought through the implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、現象のモデリングを試みろ
lines.en: Ren — attempt to model the phenomena.
lines.style: Open-ended but with authority. Slight pause before the final word, as if leaving space for thought. Encouragement underneath the direction. The tone of a mentor posing a challenge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の課題を着実にクリアーします
lines.en: Yes. I'll steadily clear through the laboratory's tasks.
lines.style: Quiet conviction closing the exchange. Steady breath, no rush. Slight rise at the end suggesting both affirmation and readiness. The voice of someone settling into commitment.
